notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one creature except Bloodghast and Scaretiller that does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one land.
description:
Activate any creature you control except Bloodghast or Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Claws of Gix twice by paying {2} and sacrificing Bloodghast and a land, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning a land to the battlefield from your graveyard tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Bloodghast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
